notable_results: Long-running ETS Modified and Stock front-runner; Bruno Coelho (Modified) and Alexandre Duchet (Stock) ETS champions on the T4; ROAR podium platform (Chris Adams). Yearly model line (T4'17 through T4'21).
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Strong both Modified and Stock pedigree. Released as an annual platform (T4'17, '18, '19, '20, '21) before the X4 succeeded it.

notable_results: Current Xray competition touring platform (X4'22 through X4'26); ETS and ROAR-level entry; Evan Huang ran Xray at the 2024 IFMAR 1:10 electric Worlds.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Annual model (X4'22, '23, '24, '25, '26) and the direct successor to the T4. Both Modified and Stock pedigree.

notable_results: Developed for the 2022 IFMAR Worlds; three back-to-back Reedy Race of Champions wins, TITC victory and ETS race wins on the IF14-2 platform.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Modified-pedigree flagship. The IF14 line is Infinity's top onroad EP platform.

notable_results: Mid-motor evolution developed through the 2023 JMRCA All Japan Championship and 2024 TITC; Jilles Groskamp won the 2024 IFMAR 1:10 Electric Touring Car World Championship on Infinity, with Teemu Leino top qualifier.
notes: Belt drive, mid-motor layout (spur near center of wheelbase, equalised front/rear belts). Modified-pedigree. Reigning electric Worlds winner brand (Groskamp 2024).

notable_results: Original IF14 EP touring platform; the IF15 prototype/IF-series lineage won the 2022 IFMAR 200mm Worlds (nitro) and underpins Infinity's electric program.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Predecessor to the IF14-2; still raced. Modified pedigree.

notable_results: Dominant ETS Stock and high-grip platform; Marc Rheinard's weapon (EFRA Euros 2024 win on the A800R, TITC podium). Sam Isaacs won the 2024 ROAR Paved Modified Nationals on Awesomatix.
notes: Unique hybrid drivetrain combining belt and shaft benefits without torque-steer; lower-mounted dampers (no traditional shock tower) for very low CG. Variants A800, A800A, A800R, A800RR/RRA/RRC, A800MMX/MMXA. Strong Stock and high-grip pedigree.

notable_results: Tested at top European races; Ronald Voelker-era ETS Modified front-runner platform (BD9/BD10/BD11 lineage), multiple ETS round wins.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Yokomo's BD line is a flagship Modified-pedigree platform (Ronald Voelker). User-friendly competition kit.

notable_results: Current Yokomo competition platform succeeding the BD11; ETS/Worlds-level Modified entry with A.T.F. (Active Top Deck Flex) and lower CG.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Direct successor to the BD11. Split front/rear upper decks with A.T.F. flex control, shortened shocks. Modified pedigree.

notable_results: Electric version of Capricorn's EFRA 1:10 Nitro Euro Championship-winning C04 platform (2022/2023 Euros, Toni Gruber); Capricorn 2nd overall (Toni Gruber) at the 2024 IFMAR Worlds.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). EP version of the nitro 200mm C04. Strong Modified/Euro pedigree.

notable_results: 2024 World Championship-edition Capricorn touring kit; Toni Gruber finished 2nd overall at the 2024 IFMAR 1:10 Onroad Worlds on the Capricorn platform.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). World Championship trim of the C04/LAB platform. Modified/Worlds pedigree (raced primarily 200mm nitro and EP onroad).

notable_results: Serpent's current 190mm competition EP touring platform (X20 '23/'24 editions); adjustable flex-bridge platform raced at club/national level.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). 190mm competition kit with Graphite (low-grip) and Aluminum (high-grip) chassis options, split top deck, flex-bridge adjustment. Successor lineage to the Serpent Project 4X.

notable_results: Serpent's 4WD EP touring platform (Project 4X / 4X EVO / 4X PRO); recent-but-still-raced national/club competition kit.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Predecessor to the Medius X20. Modified-capable competition platform.

notable_results: Shepherd 200mm touring platform (V10 / V10 AWS / V10 WC, World Champion Daniele Ielasi development); 'Ferrari' Supanun Khwanyuen ran Shepherd at the 2024 IFMAR Worlds.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Primarily a 200mm nitro-pedigree platform also run in EP onroad; AWS = Advance Weight System. Worlds-level entry.

notable_results: Tamiya's current TRF flagship competition touring car (2024 release); equal-length belts, shorter dampers, full tuning suite. National/club competition platform.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD, double-deck carbon). Successor to the TRF420/TRF420X. JMRCA-pedigree platform; both Stock and Modified capable.

notable_results: Predecessor to the TRF421; Tamiya's recent-but-still-raced TRF competition touring platform.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). The TRF421's rigid 'A' arms are 7mm longer than the TRF420X's. JMRCA/TRF-pedigree platform.

notable_results: Mugen's competition EP touring platform (MTC2 / MTC2-R); ETS/national-level entry, frequently benchmarked against the TRF421.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). The MTC2-R is the racing/team trim. Modified-capable. (Source benchmarks it directly against the TRF421.)

notable_results: ARC's mid-motor EP touring platform (R12 / R12.1) built for traction and low CG; recent-but-still-raced competition kit.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD), mid-motor double-deck with mono-block motor-mount bulkhead. Modified-capable. A FWD variant (R12FF) also exists.

notable_results: ARC's current front-motor EP touring platform (A10-23 then A11, 2023/2026); national/club competition kit.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). Conventional front-motor layout (the A10/A11 line); the R12 is ARC's mid-motor alternative. Both Modified and Stock capable.

notable_results: Schumacher's EP competition touring platform (Mi8, with a High Grip Track conversion); recent-but-still-raced national/club kit succeeded by the Mi9.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). High Grip Track conversion alters suspension geometry/shock mounts for more rotation on high-grip. Succeeded by the Mi9. Modified/Stock capable.

notable_results: VBC's fully re-engineered competition touring platform (WildFire D07/D09/D10, ~80% new parts at D10); recent-but-still-raced club/national kit.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). The WildFire line is VBC's flagship touring platform. Modified/Stock capable.

notable_results: Destiny's competition EP touring platform (RX-10SR 2.0 / 3.0 / 3.0R); updated weight balance for steering and cornering; recent-but-still-raced kit.
notes: Belt drive (dual-belt 4WD). RX-10SR line; 3.0R is the latest race trim. Stock/Modified capable club-and-national platform.

notable_results: Benchmark chassis for the US 1/10 World GT-R pan-car class (spec-tire, 17.5 blinky); a defining platform of the WGT-R class.
notes: Belt-driven 1/10 200mm PAN CAR (not a 4WD touring car) raced as its own World GT / GT-R class: spec RT-1 tires, 1S, 17.5 ROAR motor. Stock/spec pedigree.

notable_results: Current-production 1/10 World GT-R class pan car raced in the US spec WGT-R class.
notes: 1/10 200mm PAN CAR for the World GT-R spec class (CRC RT-1 control tire, 1S, 17.5 blinky). Distinct from 4WD touring; spec/Stock pedigree.
